verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing has a documented public REST API, with API reference pages for creating Cards and Cardholders, API-driven disputes, funding-balance access, real-time authorization webhooks, and a test mode for simulated purchases. Community comments independently describe it as an "API-first product" built on the Stripe API, and the docs are served as machine-readable markdown alongside llms.txt. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, since every probed openapi/swagger path returned 404.
